summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K on November 12, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that its ordinary shares will begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol OPHI at the open on November 13, 2026, after trading under CLGN through the close on November 12. No shareholder action is required; the listing and CUSIP remain unchanged. Subject to shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for November 24, 2026 and consent of the Israeli Registrar of Companies, the company intends to change its name to OptiPhi Computing Ltd, reflecting a strategic pivot toward LightSolver's all-optical Laser Processing Unit technology while retaining rhCollagen and bio-ink assets. This is a routine ticker and proposed name change, not a special situation; watch the November 24 EGM vote and registrar consent, with no deal terms or arbitrage angle.
